universe_a_liquid_reference.rules: Strictly causal US CS/ADRC common stocks ($5<=prev_close<=200, 20-day ADV >= $20M, top 30 by ADV20 per day, pre-session membership only; excludes ex-post intraday mover rows)

universe_b_morning_active.rules: Causal per-minute scanner: US CS/ADRC common stocks, $1<=close_t<=$30, close_t >= 1.10*prev_close, cum_dollar_vol_since_0400 >= $500k, top 20 per minute
universe_b_morning_active.float_note: Labeled as active low-priced-stock universe ($1-$30); point-in-time SEC shares outstanding available on subset (`pit_shares_out`), never current-snapshot float.
